title: De-Diffusing WAMs: Action-Sufficient Direct Prediction for Robot Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.28122v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cascade world-action models (WAMs) use predicted visual futures to condition robot actions, but inherit costly iterative inference from diffusion-pretrained experts. We ask what a single-step predicted future must preserve to support accurate single-step action prediction. In the evaluated WAM, resampling video noise has little effect on downstream actions, yet naively truncating both streams to one step substantially reduces task success. Video-space supervision only partially closes this gap, and a local sensitivity analysis shows that vision prediction errors have highly unequal consequences for action accuracy. These findings motivate DirectWAM, which converts pretrained video and action experts into single-step predictors without stochastic sampling through action-sufficient distillation, while retaining the explicit future-to-action cascade. After learning a one-step action model, we train the future predictor by decoding actions

translated_title: 去扩散化世界-动作模型：面向机器人控制的动作充分性直接预测
translated_abstract: 级联世界-动作模型（WAM）利用预测的视觉未来来条件化机器人的动作，但从扩散预训练的专家模型中继承了代价高昂的迭代推理。我们探究单步预测的未来必须保留什么，才能支持准确的单步动作预测。在所评估的WAM中，重新采样视频噪声对下游动作几乎没有影响，然而简单地将两个流截断为单步会显著降低任务成功率。仅使用视频空间监督只能部分弥合这一差距，且局部敏感性分析表明，视觉预测误差对动作准确性的影响高度不均等。这些发现启发了DirectWAM，它通过动作充分性蒸馏，将预训练的视频和动作专家模型转换为无需随机采样的单步预测器，同时保留显式的未来到动作的级联结构。在训练出单步动作模型之后，我们通过解码动作来训练未来预测器（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出DirectWAM，通过动作充分性蒸馏将扩散预训练的级联世界-动作模型去扩散化为单步直接预测器，在消除昂贵的迭代随机采样的同时保留显式的未来到动作级联结构，从而实现高效准确的机器人控制。
en_tdlr: DirectWAM de-diffuses diffusion-pretrained cascade world-action models into single-step direct predictors via action-sufficient distillation, eliminating costly stochastic iterative sampling while retaining the explicit future-to-action cascade for efficient and accurate robot control.
